note: Pinewoods, a Southern Unit family campground off Waterville Road: three wooded loops, with Loop 1 (sites 1-36) a pet-free 24-hour quiet zone. Walk-to sites sit 140-750 ft from their parking stalls. Four group sites (A-D) share the entrance; the forest's horseriders' campground is a separate area near Palmyra. --Claude
